text:
tom (Eng Manager): Quick question — have a report we're planning to promote L4 -> L5 with an effective date of 2026-05-15. Do we push the comp change through immediately mid-cycle or wait for the next annual review cycle? Also, is comp committee sign-off required for mid-cycle promotions?

elaine (People Ops): Congrats to them! Short answer: you can do mid-cycle comp changes. If it's a title-only promotion with no salary change, no comp workflow needed. If salary will change, follow the Comp Change Request flow.

maria (People Ops): Adding detail: if the raise is within band and <= 10% you can submit a manager justification + manager approval. If >10% or moves above the band midpoint we need calibration + finance review + director sign-off.

tom (Eng Manager): Helpful — what about equity? We were thinking a small refresh grant in addition to base bump. Same approvals apply?

maria (People Ops): Equity refresh is separate. Use the "Equity Grant Request" in the same portal. Grants > $X require compensation committee review. Please attach the promotion note + impact summary.

hamid (Finance): FYI from finance side — mid-cycle salary changes are fine but we need budget code and effective date at submission. If you want it to hit the next payroll, submit by the payroll cutoff. Otherwise it'll roll next month.

hr-bot: Reminder: Payroll cutoff for May payroll is 2026-04-28 17:00 PDT. Comp Change Requests received and approved after cutoff will apply to the following payroll. See: https://intra.redwood/payroll

tom (Eng Manager): Got it. If we submit today and approvals finish before cutoff, do we still need the comp committee?

maria (People Ops): If the comp bump is <=10% and stays within band => no committee. If >10%, above midpoint, or includes market adjustment beyond band => yes, committee. Committee meets weekly on Wednesdays.

suresh (Recruiting): Quick Q — for internal promotions that also change leveling for hiring comparisons, do we update the JD and the hiring scorecard?

jen (Director Eng): yes please update JD + scorecard. Helps with calibration later. I'm happy to sign off on packets for Eng once I see the justification + the updated scorecard. :thumbsup:

tom (Eng Manager): Thanks all. Next steps: I'll fill the Comp Change Request, attach the promo note and updated scorecard, tag @maria and @jen. Expecting to request a 12% bump and small refresh (will request committee). Any tips on wording for the manager justification?

maria (People Ops): Keep it evidence-based: impact, scope increase, peer comparisons, success metrics from the project, and proposed comp benchmarking. One-paragraph summary + bullet list of 3-4 examples works well.

tom (Eng Manager): Perfect. I'll submit today and loop back here once it's in. Appreciate the quick responses. :pray:

elaine (People Ops): If you want us to review a draft before submission, drop it here or DM me and I can give quick feedback. Good luck! :slightly_smiling_face:
